distribution.narrative: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) consistently report 黑龙江、吉林、辽宁. Beaver & Liu (2010) adds Taiwan and gives broad China; Taiwan. No additional mainland province is inferred from the broad China wording.

host_note: Baseline hosts are Picea koraiensis and Pinus koraiensis. Beaver & Liu (2010) reports Abies, Picea and Pinus at genus level; these are retained without replacing the species-level records.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Hylastes plumbeus Blandford, 1894.

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Hylastes plumbeus Blandford, 1894, VSN_2933. Beaver & Liu (2010) uses Hylastes obscurus Chapuis and treats H. plumbeus as a synonym. Current synthesis follows integrated taxonomic backbone while preserving the 2010 nomenclatural treatment at source level.
